args.title: Fix parseAmount to handle Indian rupee and Swiss franc signs
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update the parseAmount function to also remove the Indian rupee sign ₹ and the Swiss franc sign 'CHF' so amounts with these currency signs are accepted as numbers.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseAmount function in src/util/money.ts currently fails to handle the Indian rupee sign ₹ and Swiss franc 'CHF'. This causes amounts with these symbols to be rejected as invalid numbers. The pull request updates the function to properly recognize and exclude these currency symbols during parsing.
